Description: Includes core scripts for mod download, sanitization, LGSM config updates, and Swifty deployment.
Adds support for CDLCs in mods.json and config handling.
Introduce logging summary and mod consistency checker.
Menu-based system to manage mod operations via terminal.
Trigger deployments and mod updates via Discord commands.
Web UI to manage mod lists, trigger updates, and view logs.
Watch mod changes, auto-restart server, support full backups.
Cloud deployment of mods via S3, Cloudflare R2, or other CDNs.
Upload/download modpacks, use tagging and ratings in UI.
